## Hardware

> Hardware reference for the Edge AI Foundation Badge — components, pinout, and power design.

- [Overview](https://edge-ai-foundation.github.io/eaif-badge-docs/hardware/overview/): Onboard components of the Edge AI Foundation Badge.
- [Schematic](https://edge-ai-foundation.github.io/eaif-badge-docs/hardware/schematic/): Schematic and full GPIO pin map for the Edge AI Foundation Badge
- [Circuit Board](https://edge-ai-foundation.github.io/eaif-badge-docs/hardware/pcb/): PCB layout and design files for the Edge AI Foundation Badge.
- [Modular Design](https://edge-ai-foundation.github.io/eaif-badge-docs/hardware/design/): Three-layer physical design of the Edge AI Foundation Badge — faceplate, main board, and backplate.
